feeding_claim.verbatim: We finish your beef on the best grass of the season.

notes: Family ranch outside Kellerton in Ringgold County, southern Iowa; ops/leads.md listed it as having no website, but ebersolecattleco.com exists. Read homepage, our story, contact, blog index and FAQ, the half beef article and the quarter beef product page (WebFetch summaries only, so the Verifier should recheck the verbatim quote). Story page: 100% grass fed beef raised on pasture their entire lives; quarter beef page says 100% Grass Fed and Finished, regeneratively grazed. Pork (Berkshire Duroc, half hog product) and Non GMO eggs are sold but no page says how they are raised or fed, or whether they are raised on the ranch; Verifier should confirm or drop them. Quarter beef page lists home delivery included to the Des Moines metro and also 'Free Nationwide Shipping' without explaining it; no shipping policy found, so shipping left empty pending recheck. Phone is listed as call or text Shanen. No address published.
